notes: 'on every side' is divided between מִן and סָבִיב rather than fused, since the ASV spends a word on each and rule 30's one-English-word condition is unmet; contrast v.26, where nothing is left for the מִן and it goes unrepresented under rule 40.
The waw taking 'For' is rule 14's open list read off the ASV, not an added connective.
